verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p="app/(main)/codes/page.tsx",a="app/(main)/codes/actions.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(p)||!fs.existsSync(a)){console.error("SCAN-775: a file the probe must read is missing");process.exit(79)}const page=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"),act=fs.readFileSync(a,"utf8");const listNullOnly=/\.is\([\x27"]space_id[\x27"], null\)/.test(page)&&!/space_id\.is\.null,space_id\.eq\./.test(page);const cnt=act.match(/count: [\x27"]exact[\x27"][\s\S]*?MARKETING_CODE_LIMIT/);const countIgnoresSpace=!cnt||!/space_id/.test(cnt[0]);if(listNullOnly||countIgnoresSpace){console.error("SCAN-775: personal marketing codes never show on /codes but still count toward the 3-code limit: "+(listNullOnly?"the list still requires a null space_id that the root-stamping trigger never leaves; ":"")+(countIgnoresSpace?"the limit count still ignores space_id so Space codes eat the personal quota.":""));process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: The /codes marketing list required space_id IS NULL, but the qr_codes_default_space_id trigger stamps every null space_id with the root Space, so the list matched nothing; the limit count in createMarketingCode had no space filter, so a member's Space codes (owner stamped, purpose null) ate the personal quota. Added personalMarketingSpaceFilter(rootSpaceId) in lib/qr/marketing.ts (space_id null or root, the same rule as associations.ts and campaigns.ts) and applied it to both the page list and the create count via loadRootSpaceId. Pinned by app/(main)/codes/actions.test.ts: a runtime mock-backed count (three Space codes still allow a create; three root-stamped personal codes refuse; a legacy null-space code counts) plus a source-shape check that neither side uses a bare null space_id and both call the shared helper.
